migrations.reason: Added composite app support: port coordination across multiple services in a monorepo. The new compositeApp field tracks assigned ports, the shared ports.env path, and service relationships. New step IDs (coordinate-ports, write-ports-env, patch-source-file) record what anito_coordinate did so anito setup --refresh can update managed blocks without re-asking the developer. This change is fully backwards-compatible — existing single-service state files at v1.0.0 are unaffected.
migrations.instructions: No action required. The compositeApp field is optional. Existing single-service projects at schema v1.0.0 continue to work without changes. To opt in to composite app coordination for a multi-service repo, run: anito setup (CLI) or call anito_coordinate via the MCP server.
